title: Supergirl Being Super TPB DC 2018 Mariko Tamaki Joelle Jones Collects 1-4
condition_description: Sticker residue on the front cover (lower left, by the spine) and on the back cover (lower right edge); light corner wear. Binding intact. See photos.
description:
Supergirl: Being Super trade paperback (DC Comics, 2018), ISBN 978-1-4012-6894-7. Collects the 4-issue prestige miniseries: Kara Danvers' coming-of-age origin in Midvale. Written by Eisner winner Mariko Tamaki, art by Joelle Jones, inks by Sandu Florea, colors by Kelly Fitzpatrick. $16.99 cover price.

Condition: sticker residue on the front cover (lower left, by the spine) and on the back cover (lower right edge), with light corner wear (see close-ups). Binding intact.

Ships in a protective mailer.
